item.title: Design Follows Data Structures
item.description:
📝 It’s less that the “machine details and constant factors” faction was wrong, and more that the details that matter have changed. Compilers have gotten so much better at optimizing code that we’re far more likely to be bottlenecked on what compilers aren’t optimizing: memory layout. Why can’t compilers optimize data structures.
🔗 Read more: https://www.tedinski.com/2019/01/29/data-structures-are-fundamental.html
